function.name: calculate_electric_current
function.description: Calculate the electric current through a conductor given voltage and resistance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

voltage.description: The voltage across the conductor in Volts. This is a float type value.

resistance.description: The resistance of the conductor in Ohms. This is a float type value.

conductance.description: The conductance of the conductor in Siemens. Optional if resistance is provided. Default: 0.3 This is a float type value.

message.content:
電力（電）並不是由某一個人「發現」的，而是經過多位科學家逐步揭示其本質與規律。以下是幾個關鍵人物和里程碑：

| 時期 | 科學家 | 主要貢獻 |
|------|--------|----------|
| 古希臘 | 泰勒斯（Thales） | 觀察到靜電（用燈籠摩擦產生的靜電吸附） |
| 1600 年代 | 威廉·吉爾伯特（William Gilbert） | 在《De Magnete》一書中將磁性與靜電區分，提出「電」這一術語 |
| 1700 年代 | 本傑明·富蘭克林（Benjamin Franklin） | 以風箏實驗證明雷電是靜電，提出正負電荷概念 |
| 1800 年代 | 阿萊桑德羅·伏打（Alessandro Volta） | 發明伏打電池，首次提供持續電流 |
| 1800 年代 | 赫爾曼·冯·亥姆霍兹（Heinrich Hertz） | 觀測到電磁波，證實馬克士威的電磁理論 |

簡而言之，電力的「發現」是一個漸進的歷史過程，從古代對靜電的觀察，到近代對電流、電壓、電阻等概念的建立，形成了今天我們所熟知的電學基礎。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "誰發現了電力？" meaning "Who discovered electricity?" They want an answer. We can provide a concise answer: Electricity was known since antiquity, but its systematic study began with scientists like William Gilbert, Benjamin Franklin, Alessandro Volta, etc. The discovery of electricity as a phenomenon is not attributed to a single person; early observations by Thales, then William Gilbert's work on magnetism and static electricity, Benjamin Franklin's kite experiment, Volta's battery, etc. So answer accordingly. No function call needed.
